text: Maggie Shaw, at the workshop. They worked together. You could try there.
direction: Mrs Baines, a middle-aged London innkeeper. Mature warm slightly husky voice with a subtle working London accent; practical and worried, never theatrical. Low contralto, lightly husky, rounded vowels and brisk practical phrasing. Familiar warmth comes through even when worried; stress household details with matter-of-fact emphasis.
